english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something becoming visible or arising, including a new pattern or structure.
Use this for the event of someone or something coming into sight or becoming visible.

examples.english: The gradual emergence of a new cooperation pattern is changing the team.
As soon as he made an appearance, everyone went quiet.
examples.traditional: 佢一出現，大家即刻靜晒。
